name: Restaurant
description: Restaurant management suite — menu with categories, modifier groups and combos, 86-ing and dayparts; a browser POS register with table/floor management, split/merge checks, discounts and tips; card-present payments via Stripe Terminal plus cash; standalone customer records; and a public online-ordering storefront (menu, cart, checkout with hosted Stripe payment or pay-at-pickup) that drops orders into the POS. Part of a SpotOn-style suite (KDS, reservations, loyalty, labor and reporting to follow).
author: Kohevo
